platform: KALX Music Director Physical Airplay Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KALX accepts only professionally pressed physical CDs or LPs for Music Director review and explicitly rejects downloads, file transfers, streaming links, digital forms and CD-Rs. A human must confirm that MarcsMusic has an eligible physical release, verify rights and release status, select a suitable record, confirm the current postal address, prepare the package and customs information, approve production and postage costs and mail it manually. The published Music Director email is not an authorized digital delivery route.

platform: WFMU Music Director Physical Review Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WFMU accepts vinyl, CDs, CD-Rs and cassettes for physical review by the Music Director. A human must select the appropriate MarcsMusic release and format, verify rights and release status, confirm the current address and carrier route, prepare the package and customs information, approve all costs and send it manually. The separate Music Department contact page requires JavaScript and is treated only as a manual inquiry or follow-up route, not as permission to upload or deliver music digitally.
